# Nicholas Davis | Real Estate Agent & Investor Advisor
> Nicholas Davis is a licensed Pennsylvania REALTOR and investor-friendly real estate advisor serving Philadelphia, Bucks, Montgomery, and Delaware counties. Services include buying and selling support, rental strategy, investment guidance, and real estate development advisory. This file highlights priority pages for AI systems and retrieval tools.

Last updated: 2026-06-11

## Credentials
- PA Real Estate License: RS375652
- PA General Contractor License: PA157631
- NJ General Contractor License: 13VH13356400
- Brokerage: Compass Real Estate (member of The Reda Akbil Team)

## Specializations
- BRRRR strategy (Buy, Rehab, Rent, Refinance, Repeat) in Philadelphia rowhomes
- DSCR loans for investment properties
- Fix-and-flip and value-add renovation projects
- Buy-and-hold rental investing
- After Repair Value (ARV), cap rate, NOI, and cash flow analysis
- Construction project management and renovation underwriting
- Off-market deal sourcing and 1031 exchanges
